assets.name: examples
assets.context: e "Next up, we have the window and button style properties. These apply to windows like the text window at the bottom of this screen and frames like the ones we show examples in."

assets.name: two
assets.context: e "To demonstrate styles, let me first show two of the images we'll be using. This is the image we're using for parts of the bar that are empty."

assets.name: here,
assets.context: e "Finally, there's one style we can't show here, and it's unscrollable. It controls what happens when a scrollbar can't be moved at all."

assets.name: you
assets.context: e "We've already seen the b, i, s, and u tags, but there are lot more than those. I'll show you the rest of them."

assets.name: into
assets.context: e "The 'dissolve' transition is probably the most useful, blending one scene into another."

assets.name: you
assets.context: e "This lets us specify very complex transitions, fairly simply. Let's try some, and then I'll show you how they work."

assets.name: things.

assets.name: them

assets.name: one

assets.name: that

assets.name: to
assets.context: e "The PushMove transitions use the new scene to push the old one out. Let's take a look."

assets.name: and
assets.context: e "Finally, there are the zoomin and zoomout transitions, which show and hide things using a zoom."

assets.name: you
assets.context: e "The AlphaDissolve transition lets you use one displayable to combine two others. Click, and I'll show you an example."

assets.name: you

assets.context: e "When ATL is used as part of a show statement, values of properties exist even when the transform is changed. So even though your click stopped the motion, the image remains in the same place." id tutorial_atl_1dd345c6

assets.name: you
assets.context: e "But before I can show you how to write dialogue, let me show you how we present script examples."

assets.name: up
assets.context: "Eileen" "Examples will show up in a window like the one above. You'll need to click outside of the example window in order to advance the tutorial."

assets.name: you

assets.name: the
assets.context: e "When this say statement is run, Ren'Py will look up the short name, which is really a Python variable. It will then use the associated Character to show the dialogue."

assets.name: images,
assets.context: e "Before we can show images, we must first choose image names, then place the image files into the images directory."

assets.name: and
assets.context: e "Here's the script for that scene. Notice how it includes two new statements, the scene and show statement."

assets.name: statement
assets.context: e "The scene statement clears the screen, and then adds a background image."

assets.name: statement
assets.context: e "The show statement adds a new image on top of all the other images on the screen."

assets.name: statement
assets.context: e "The second show statement has an at clause, which gives a location on the screen. Common locations are left, right, and center, but you can define many more."

assets.name: logo
assets.context: show logo base at rightish behind eileen

assets.name: an
assets.context: e "In this example, we show an image named logo base, and we show it at a creator-defined position, rightish."

assets.name: statement
assets.context: e "Since the show statement replaces an image, and the scene statement clears the scene, it's pretty rare to hide an image."

assets.name: is
assets.context: e "The main use is for when a character or prop leaves before the scene is over."

assets.name: you
assets.context: e "When the standard positions that come with Ren'Py aren't enough for you, you can create your own. Here, I'll show you the easy way to do it."

assets.name: an
assets.context: e "The first way to do it is to show an image followed by a colon. Then indented on the next couple of lines are the xalign and yalign transform properties."

assets.name: statement.
assets.context: e "Once a transform has been defined, you can use it in the at clause of the show statement."

assets.name: change
assets.context: e "To help take some of edge off a change in scene, Ren'Py supports the use of transitions. Let's try that scene change again, but this time we'll use transitions."

assets.name: to
assets.context: e "It uses the with statement. The with statement causes the scene to transition from the last things shown to the things currently being shown."

assets.name: the
assets.context: e "I'll work from the inside out to describe the statements. But first, I'll show the screen so you can see it in action."

assets.name: screen
assets.context: e "The first is the show screen statement, which displays a screen and lets Ren'Py keep going."

assets.name: screen
assets.context: e "Generally, you use show screen to show overlays that are up all the time, and call screen to show screens the player interacts with for a little while."

assets.name: screen
assets.context: show screen parameter_screen(_("Hello, world."), cancel=Notify(_("You can't cancel this.")))

assets.name: screen
assets.context: e "The call screen statement can also take arguments, much like show screen does."

assets.name: b_tag_screen,
assets.context: e "When I show b_tag_screen, it replaces a_tag_screen."

assets.name: displayables.
assets.context: e "The screen language has a few statements that do things other than show displayables. If you haven't seen the section on {a=jump:warp_screen_displayables}Screen Displayables{/a} yet, you might want to check it out, then come back here."

assets.name: the
assets.context: e "Here, we moved the statements that show the text and bar into a second screen, and the use statement includes that screen in the first one."

assets.name: statement
assets.context: e "The at property applies a transform to the displayable, the same way the at clause in the show statement does."

assets.name: dialogue.
assets.context: e "The id property is mostly used with the say screen, which is used to show dialogue. Outside of the say screen, it isn't used much."

assets.name: bars
assets.context: e "The bar and vbar displayables are flexible displayables that show bars representing a value. The value can be static, animated, or adjustable by the player."

assets.name: buttons
assets.context: e "Imagemaps use two or more images to show buttons and bars. Let me start by showing you an example of an imagemap in action."

assets.name: you
assets.context: e "To demonstrate how imagemaps are put together, I'll show you the five images that make up a smaller imagemap."

assets.name: up
assets.context: e "Notice how both the bar and button are highlighted in this image. When we display them as part of a screen, only one of them will show up as focused."

assets.name: a
assets.context: e "The first way allows you to show a movie as an image, along with every other image that's displayed on the screen."

assets.name: the
assets.context: e "Then, we can show the movie displayable, which starts the movie playing."

assets.name: python
assets.context: e "The other way to show a movie is with the renpy.movie_cutscene python function. This shows the movie fullscreen, either until it ends or until the user clicks."

assets.context: e "Généralement, vous utilisez 'show screen' pour montrer ce qui est tout le temps affiché et 'call screen' pour montrer les écrans qui interagissent durant un instant avec le joueur."

assets.name: 명령문의
assets.context: e "ATL이 show 명령문의 부품으로 사용될 때, 변형이 변경되더라도 특성의 값은 존재해. 따라서 클릭으로 동작이 중단되더라도 이미지는 같은 위치에 유지되지."

assets.name: 문을
assets.context: e "연필 아이콘으로 명령문을 편집하거나 제거할 수 있어. show 문을 편집하고 '(transform)', 'right' 및 'change'를 클릭하여 나를 오른쪽으로 이동할 수 있어."

assets.name: 문이
assets.context: e "이건 예제 장면의 스크립트야. 두 개의 새로운 명령문인 scene과 show 문이 어떻게 포함되어 있는지 확인해둬."

assets.name: 문은
assets.context: e "show 문은 화면의 다른 모든 이미지 위에 이미지를 추가하고."

assets.name: 문은
assets.context: e "두 번째 show 문은 위치를 부여하는 절을 가지고 있어. 기본 정의된 위치에는 왼쪽(left)과 오른쪽(right), 가운데(center)가 있지만 더 많은 것을 직접 정의할 수도 있어."

assets.name: 문은
assets.context: e "show 문이 이미지를 대체하고 scene 문은 장면을 지우니까 이미지를 숨기는 일은 거의 없어."

assets.name: 문의
assets.context: e "정의된 변형은 show 문의 at 절에서 사용할 수 있어."

assets.name: screen
assets.context: e "첫 번째 show screen 명령문은 렌파이가 표시하는 스크린을 유지해."

assets.name: screen으로,
assets.context: e "일반적으로, 항상 오버레이로 보여지는 것들을 show screen으로, 플레이어의 상호작용에 따라 잠시 화면에 표시될 것들을 call screen으로 사용해."

assets.name: screen처럼

assets.name: 문에서
assets.context: e "at 속성은 show 문에서 at 절이 수행하는 것과 같은 방법으로 표시 가능한 객체에 변형을 적용해."

assets.name: и
assets.context: e "Вот код этой сцены. Заметьте, что он включает в себя два новых оператора — scene и show."

assets.name: очищает
assets.context: e "Оператор scene очищает экран и добавляет изображение на фон."

assets.name: добавляет
assets.context: e "Оператор show добавляет изображение поверх других."

assets.name: очищает
assets.context: e "Так как оператор show заменяет изображение, а оператор scene очищает экран, скрывать изображения приходится редко."

assets.name: screen,
assets.context: e "Первый — show screen, который показывает экран, а Ren'Py идёт дальше."

assets.name: screen,
assets.context: e "В основном, вам пригодится show screen, чтобы показывать элементы, которые видны всё время, а call screen — чтобы показывать короткие интерактивные экраны."

assets.name: screen语句，它显示一个界面并让Ren'Py继续运行。
assets.context: e "第一个是show screen语句，它显示一个界面并让Ren'Py继续运行。"

assets.name: screen来显示一直处于开启状态的覆盖，而用call
assets.context: e "通常，您使用show screen来显示一直处于开启状态的覆盖，而用call screen来显示与玩家短暂交互的界面。"

assets.name: screen',
assets.context: e "La primera es la sentencia 'show screen', que muestra una pantalla y le permite a Ren'Py seguir adelante."

assets.name: screen
assets.context: e "Por lo general, usas 'show screen' para mostrar capas que están arriba todo el tiempo, y 'call screen' para mostrar las pantallas con las que el jugador interactúa por un tiempo."

assets.name: screen'.
assets.context: e "La sentencia 'call screen' también puede tomar argumentos, como lo hace 'show screen'."

assets.name: замість
assets.context: e "І нарешті, блок ATL можна використовувати як частину оператора show замість пропозиції at." id tutorial_atl_da7a7759

assets.name: та
assets.context: e "Ось скрипт цієї сцени. Зверніть увагу, що він містить два нових оператори, оператор scene та show."

assets.name: очищає
assets.context: e "Оператор scene очищає екран, а потім додає фонове зображення."

assets.name: додає
assets.context: e "Оператор show додає нове зображення поверх усіх інших зображень на екрані."

assets.name: має
assets.context: e "Другий оператор show має властивість at, яка вказує розташування на екрані. Типовими розташуваннями є left, right і center, але ви можете визначити багато інших."

assets.name: очищає
assets.context: e "Оскільки оператор show замінює зображення, а оператор scene очищає сцену, досить рідко можна приховати зображення."

assets.name: screen,
assets.context: e "Перший — оператор show screen, який відображає екран і дозволяє Ren'Py продовжувати роботу."

assets.name: screen,
assets.context: e "Як правило, ви використовуєте show screen, щоб показувати елементи, які постійно активні, і call screen, щоб показувати екрани, з якими гравець взаємодіє деякий час."

assets.name: screen.
assets.context: e "Оператор call screen також може приймати аргументи, подібно до show screen."
